newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank drops rediscount rate.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank drops rediscount rate.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Tuesday it had lowered its rediscount rate to 10.593 percent from the previous 11.029.
The rate is calculated every month at one percentage point below the average 91-day Treasury bill rate of the last weekly auction in the previous month. Monday's auction average was 11.593 percent.
The Central Bank said in a statement that lending through its rediscount window reached 6.521 billion persos from January 2 to September 26.
Of this amount, 4.051 billion pesos went to exporters, and 2.47 billion pesos to the farm sector.
The Central Bank's rediscount window is not used as a tool to control money supply but to provide concessional financing to selected sectors.
